title: Archovive Kernel Execution Envelope v1
description: Canonical kernel input. Surfaces translate invocation context into this envelope before calling f(job).

repo_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository snapshot root

repo_name.description: Logical repository identifier used in DecisionRecord.repo

commit_ref.description: Optional VCS commit identifier binding the snapshot

policy_pack_ids.description: Ordered policy pack identifiers applied by kernel

mode.description: Kernel execution mode (analysis only; no surface semantics)

baseline_ref.description: Optional baseline fingerprint for drift computation
